detail.longDescription: The Signal Protocol in Rust TL;DR: I have open-sourced a # Rust implementation of the # SignalProtocol that compiles to # WASM for # Browser -based # P2P messaging, overcoming the # Nodejs limitations of the official library. I am sharing my implementation of the Signal Protocol designed specifically for the # Frontend . While the official libsignal is the gold standard, its # JavaScript targets are often optimized for Node.js, which creates integration challenges for client-side web applications. My version is built in # RustLang and compiles to # WebAssembly , utilizing # ModuleFederation to provide robust # Encryption for decentralized environments. It currently powers the end-to-end security for my series of # P2P messaging projects. Protocol Demo: https:// signal.positive-intentions.com/ P2P Messaging roadmap: https:// glitr.io/docs/technical/roadmap I am looking for feedback from the # Dev and # Infosec community. If you have experience with # Cryptography audits or formal-proof verification, I would appreciate your eyes on the codebase as I work toward a more finished state.
